g.text: Critical vulnerability on an internet-exposed host ──────────────────
The same in-scope host exposes a network service AND carries a high or critical vulnerability.
Provenance ties the vulnerability back to the exposed host, so this is a directly reachable,
Injection vulnerability on a live host ──────────────────────────
A discovered service and a high-severity injection finding (SQLi/XSS) resolve to the same
in-scope host — an exploitable web flaw on a confirmed live target, not an isolated scanner hit.
Evidence: Open Ports Discovered, SQL injection in `id` parameter
Reconnaissance, content discovery, and an injection finding were all seen against the target —
the ingredients of a path from recon to code execution through the web application.
Evidence: Open Ports Discovered, A record, Endpoints discovered, SQL injection in `id` parameter
